subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Condition Monitoring: Listening to Bearings
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Condition Monitoring: Listening to Bearings.

hook.text: A healthy bearing hums. A dying one screams — if you can hear it.

buildup.text: Vibration sensors detect tiny changes in motion long before failure.

discovery.text: Each defect — inner race, outer race, ball — has a unique frequency.

twist.text: AI now analyzes vibration and predicts failure weeks in advance.

climax.text: Predictive upkeep saves factories millions by replacing parts just in time.

punchline.text: Listen to your bearings and they'll tell you when.

quiz.question: How can vibration analysis identify the type of bearing defect?
options: Different defect locations produce unique vibration frequencies
The bearing changes color depending on which part is damaged
Temperature sensors detect which part is hottest
